messages:
Elena: Heads up — QBR with Meridian on Fri 10:00am. Need final slide deck + a 2-min exec summary on renewal risks and onboarding status. Can we confirm owners?
Maya: I can own onboarding status slide. I'll pull latest checklist + enablement logs.
Jared: I'll do renewal risks + mitigation plan. Need renewal health score + any exec asks.
Priya: I have the NPS followup notes and recent support tickets — will add a 1-slide snapshot.
Sam (CSE): Quick note — there's one outstanding onboarding task for Meridian: SSO config and a training session that never happened. That raises risk on usage.
Ben (CS Ops): @Sam (CSE) can you paste the ticket #? I'll escalate to engineering if it's blocking.
Sam (CSE): Ticket #4529. Root cause: config mismatch + doc gap. ETA on fix from infra is EOD today.
Maya: Good — I'll include status: ticket open, fix ETA, and customer-facing enablement next steps.
Elena: For exec asks we should surface: 1) approval for 1 additional training seat 2) fast-tracked SSO patch 3) proposed credit for delayed onboarding. Keep asks crisp.
Jared: Draft ask text: "Request approval for a one-time operational credit and priority patching to protect renewal" — I'll flesh out numbers.
Priya: On feedback capture, I recommend we show the top 3 friction points from user interviews (SSO, dashboard latency on large jobs, billing visibility). I can attach verbatim quotes.
Elena: Great. Also want a short risk matrix: Green/Yellow/Red with thresholds (usage < 30% => yellow, churn signal if <15% and support escalations >2).
Ben (CS Ops): I'll export usage and last 30-day active seats. Sharing sheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/qbrs/meridian-prep (placeholder)
Maya: Can we include a mini-runbook for the on-call patcher in the appendix? Sample snippet: ```steps:
- Validate SSO certs
- Apply patch v1.2.3
- Smoke test login flow
- Notify customer and schedule training```
Sam (CSE): I'll own the runbook and add screenshots.
Elena: Deadline: please drop your slide drafts in the shared deck by Thu 4pm. I'll assemble and send to execs Thu 5pm.
Jared: Noted. I'll include the proposed credit calc: 10% of April invoice + one training session.
Priya: Will attach NPS snippets and support log excerpts.
Elena: Also capture asks for Product: can we request a perf investigation for dashboard latency? @Jared please add product owner contact.
Jared: @Priya product lead is Omar — I'll ping him for a 15-min alignment.
qbr-bot: Reminder: QBR slide template v2 is available in the templates folder. Deadline in 48h. :bell:
Ben (CS Ops): Action items quick list:
- Maya: onboarding slide + runbook (Thu 4pm)
- Jared: renewal risk slide + credit calc + ping Product (Thu 4pm)
- Priya: feedback + NPS + support excerpts (Thu 4pm)
- Sam (CSE): runbook screenshots + ticket update (EOD today)
- Elena: assemble deck + exec notes (Thu 5pm)
Elena: Perfect — I'll follow up with an exec rehearsal on Fri 9:15am. If any blockers surface, ping me here. :thumbsup:
